messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: MSstats in R
parts:
Hi,

there are some examples for contrast matrix creation in package documentation and at https://msstats.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/MSstats_v3.18.1_manual_2020Feb26-v2.pdf
In short, you encode comparisons by -1 and 1 for contrasts of interest (when two groups are compared in each contrasts, 0 for other groups), and you need to create a matrix where each column is named after a group and each row corresponds to one comparison.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
